title: Without LAVC there would be no TheatreIsLife, simple as that! #rentmu...
transcript: if you love musical theatre but especially if you love rent and live in LA then listen up some of the most talented theatre artists I know are putting on a production of rent to help raise money for Los Angeles Valley College LavC is a community college with a theatre program and a lot of my friends went there before transferring to a larger school to get their Bfaa or their mfa it's a great way to get a degree and save a ton of money and so much of my hands on experience in theatre came from either Valley College or the people that I met at Valley College unfortunately they were supposed to get a new theatre space literally years ago I went there 10 years ago and they were talking about this new space all the way back then the old space has already been torn down the new space is in the process of being built but it keeps getting delayed and with cuts to arts funding programs like this take a major hit that's where my friends come in to help raise money for the college now if you can go to the show it is pay what you can they recommend $25 but you can pay more than that if you want if you are not in Los Angeles however you can still help they are running a gofundme right now this is going to be LinkedIn my bio tree when I tell you if you are in Los Angeles you are not gonna Wanna miss this production and you can buy tickets now I will also link to the tickets link in my bio
